lab_prompts <- c(

## What you will do

Open this file and click **Run Document**. Packages: `learnr`, `fpp3`.
Exercise chunks run when you click Run Code. They are not knitted in one pass.

## Bake-off
```{r bakeoff-ex, exercise=TRUE, exercise.lines=18}
library(fpp3)
beer <- aus_production |>
  select(Quarter, Beer) |>
  filter(!is.na(Beer))
train <- beer |> filter(Quarter <= max(Quarter) - 8)
test  <- beer |> filter(Quarter >  max(Quarter) - 8)

fit <- train |>
  model(
    snaive = SNAIVE(Beer),
    ets = ETS(Beer),
    arima = ARIMA(Beer)
  )
fc <- fit |> forecast(h = nrow(test))
fc |> accuracy(beer) |> select(.model, RMSE, MAE, MASE)
# Residuals for your preferred model, e.g.:
fit |> select(ets) |> gg_tsresiduals()
```

```{r q1}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q1"]],
  answer("SNAIVE, ETS, ARIMA (same split, same metrics)", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Only in-sample AICc across families"),
  answer("Only training MAPE"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q2}
question(
  lab_prompts[["q2"]],
  answer("Innovations look like white noise (no leftover pattern)", correct = TRUE),
  answer("Forecasts equal the seasonal indices exactly"),
  allow_retry = TRUE,
  random_answer_order = TRUE
)
```

```{r q3}
question_text(
  lab_prompts[["q3"]],
  open_answer(),
  placeholder = "I recommend … because RMSE/MAE … caveat …",
  trim = TRUE
)
```

```{r submit-server, context="server"}
output$download_txt <- shiny::downloadHandler(
  filename = function() lab_submission_filename(input$student_name, lab_meta$id),
  content = function(file) {
    write_lab_submission(
      path = file,
      name = input$student_name,
      lab_id = lab_meta$id,
      lab_title = lab_meta$title,
      state = learnr::get_tutorial_state(),
      prompts = lab_prompts
    )
  }
)
```
